crossRefs.note: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.
know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.
On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in…
withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.
when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come…
Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;
for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant…

translations.kjv: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth
